gpu_usage.reason: nvidia-smi is unavailable (common for cloud/API generation).

aesthetic_quality_proxy.note: Heuristic aesthetic proxy from sharpness, exposure and colour; do not present as a learned aesthetic score.

scene_consistency_temporal_ssim.note: Adjacent sampled frames; high values indicate stable appearance, not necessarily realism.

temporal_flicker.note: Mean adjacent-frame luminance change; intended motion can increase this value.

motion_smoothness_optical_flow.note: Mean change in dense optical flow between adjacent samples.

subject_consistency_proxy.note: Central 50% x 60% crop SSIM proxy; assumes the person is centred.

background_consistency_proxy.note: Outer-border SSIM proxy; assumes a mostly fixed camera.

prompt_adherence_clip.note: Higher means stronger image–prompt alignment; compare within one study.

object_consistency.reason: Requires labelled object detections across a test set; do not infer it from a single asset.

character_consistency.reason: Requires identity annotations or face embeddings across video frames/test cases.

hallucination_rate.reason: Requires a labelled set of requested objects versus generated objects.
